

### Reflection questions {.unnumbered}

Using the structural equations:

1.  Show that independence does not hold in the model defined by @eq-fullly-connected-dag.

2.  Show that independence holds in @eq-independence-dag.

3.  Show that the causal estimand in @sec-classic-causal-inference is equivalent to the usual definition of average causal effect (ACE)

4. Show that the causal estimate in @sec-classic-causal-inference is equivalent to the usual definition of the g-formula.

5. How is the SUTVA assumption encoded in this model?
